events.title: Christmas Eve Candle Light Service at The Cowboy Church
events.location: The Cowboy Church 17525 Highway 65 NE., Ham Lake, MN  55304
events.description:
Celebrate the wonder of Christmas with us at The Cowboy Church! Join us for a beautiful, peaceful candlelight service as we pause from the busyness of the season to remember the greatest gift of all — Jesus Christ, our Savior.

Bring your family, invite a friend, and share in a special evening of worship, reflection, and Christmas joy. We would love to celebrate the birth of our Savior with you!

events.title: GriefShare - Grief Support Group
events.description:
The loss of a loved one turns your world upside down.
GriefShare support groups help you find the path toward stability, healing, and hope.

Please join us: Weekly starting at 5:00 PM, Tuesday, December 8th.
Register here: https://find.griefshare.org/groups/307059
Feel free to contact Pastor Jeremiah at jeremiahw@cowboychurch.org, or visit griefshare.org, if you have questions or would like more information.

events.title: Jam Session
events.description:
All are welcome! Musicians and spectators!

Stay for lunch in the Hungry Cowboy Cafe.
Then let's Jam from 12:30 - 2:30 p.m. in the Multi-Purpose room off the gym.
Stay and linger with the music, it's good for the soul!

events.title: Sunday Message: A Control Freak's Guide To Letting Go
events.description:
A CONTROL FREAK'S GUIDE TO LETTING GO
When Life Won't Cooperate
Ever feel like the harder you try to control things, the more out of control they get? People won't cooperate and plans fall apart. And sometimes life takes a turn you never saw coming. This Sunday, November 15, we'll meet a man in Genesis who thought he could control just about anything—until he faced a situation that threatened to change everything.
Join us at 10 am this Sunday, Nov. 15, at Cowboy Church, located at Hwy 65 and Crosstown Blvd. in Ham Lake. Come as you are—and bring a friend. You belong here!

events.title: Roundup Recovery
events.description:
Struggling with addiction, grief, trauma or life's challenges? You don't have to face it alone.
Join us for a Christ-centered recovery journey using the Life Recovery Bible and Life Recovery Workbook as tools for restoration.  Along with biblical principles to liveyour life stronger in Christ.
